name: onyx-debian-trixie
notes: base/compose.sh stages this rootfs with debootstrap, drops in deploy/systemd + tmpfiles + files/usr/lib/sysusers.d + deploy/libexec helpers, enables the onyx units, and commits the result to an OSTree repo; base/image/assemble-boot.sh then turns the commit into a bootable A/B sysroot (docs/design/10).
